result:
I’d make empathy involuntary.

Not politeness, not sympathy, not “thinking of the less fortunate”—but the raw, unavoidable ability to feel, briefly and unmistakably, what another person is carrying.

Most cruelty, indifference, and self-deception would collapse once people couldn’t pretend other minds weren’t real.
